nodes.label: E(X) = |R(X)| − |X|, the excess measure
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: E is defined so that it measures whether an INDEX can carry a constraint, not whether a physical claim is true; E(X)=0 iff the binary constraint network is globally consistent. The precedent chosen is the periodic table, whose defect of 36 is explicitly 'a fact about a drawing'.

nodes.label: R, the monotone pairwise envelope closure
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: R uses only the cells: 'No outside knowledge enters R(X): it is what a reader could reconstruct from the cells alone.' That is why a derived coordinate cannot repair closure.

nodes.label: The two failure modes — ordering and arity
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Stated as the paper's thesis, with everything after it as instances. No third mode was found; the axis index looked like one and resolved to sub-case A.

nodes.label: Sub-case A — ordering failure, repairable by re-ordering
nodes.author: Matthew Lach

nodes.label: Sub-case B — arity failure, not repairable by any coordinate operation
nodes.author: Matthew Lach

nodes.label: Λ, the atomic-structure lattice
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: 8-tuples (n, ℓ, k, q, e, f, g, 2S) built by nested bounds; closes at every level of the tower to Λ₁₃ and in all four coupling schemes — but closure does not certify the letters (7 of 13 conflated).

nodes.label: The eighteen-column periodic table, E = 36
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The defect is ordering, not placement: ℓ as a function of group is non-monotone. Dropping group and keeping ℓ gives E = 0 immediately, which is what Janet's block order f, d, p, s does.

nodes.label: The violation index at nine letters (E = 30, core one cell)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach

nodes.label: The violation index at fifteen letters (E = 816, core one cell)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Doubling the alphabet moved multiplicity 30 → 816 and carried no information: the structural results are about the operator, not the encoding.

nodes.label: The corrected fifteen-letter alphabet
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Five conflated letters split (X, U, NEC, L, SD) and EOM added, because each conflation merged an inert rung with a potent one — the index was graded from papers about what breaks, and the papers that matter for atomic structure are about what holds.

nodes.label: An index's conflations are invisible from inside it
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Twenty-one structural audits passed on a document containing five conflations, because self-audits compare the index against itself and no self-audit can catch a word that means something else elsewhere.

nodes.label: Audit 22 — term match, and the vocabulary debt
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: External by construction and therefore unable to join the automated suite; its output is a debt (32 of 48 pairs unchecked), not a pass. The 56% conflation rate among the checked 16 must not be extrapolated — they were selected because something forced them.

nodes.label: Audit 23 — published values, the only external validation
nodes.author: Matthew Lach

nodes.label: Audit 24 — unbacked numeric claims
nodes.author: Matthew Lach

nodes.label: Audit 27 — the possibility bound 0 ≤ E ≤ box − cells
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Its coverage gap is structural: five objects report a defect without recording a box and cannot be checked at all, which is how 8,856 survived. The procedure that closes it is to report the box alongside every defect.

nodes.label: The 8,856 slide-within-rows figure, refuted by a bound
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The first arithmetic error the register contains; every prior entry was a wrong inference from correct arithmetic. Corrected to 5 against a ceiling of 40.

nodes.label: The BFV four-vocabulary partition T/M/A/S
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Derived rather than chosen: a locally covariant QFT is a functor A : Loc → Alg, and that object has exactly four parts. Three of the earlier seven vocabularies dissolve, and the terms that refuse to place are relations between parts, not properties.

nodes.label: The severed system graph, withdrawn as a partition artefact
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: On T/M/A/S the graph is complete — 4 nodes, 6 edges, one component — so the six repairs failed on ARITY, which was always the explanation; the graph story was decoration on a partition since withdrawn. §8.5 and §8.7 are retained as HISTORY because the correction is only legible against what it corrects.

nodes.label: The Admission Law
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: An open index admits any content together with its verification grade; a derived entry carries the minimum grade of its inputs and no derivation raises a grade. A collision is discharged by re-deriving the internal result, never by refusing the content — every substantive repair in the work arrived as a collision.

nodes.label: The merge rule — a biconditional must hold at every rung
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Merging on a fact true at one point and then grading the axis is the error; correctly applied, the rule would have caught five of the nine coordinates before they were built.

nodes.label: The closure rule for tightenings
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A tightening preserves E = 0 if and only if it binds one coordinate by a monotone function of one other.

nodes.label: E requires density, asymmetrically
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: E = 0 is informative at any density; E > 0 at low density measures sparsity rather than structure. A late finding that qualifies every number in the paper.

nodes.label: The six blindnesses of the envelope
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Includes the exclusion of the entire class of derived-coordinate repairs, for any index: R reconstructs from cells alone, so it cannot see that a coordinate was defined from others while the box grows and |X| stays fixed.

nodes.label: The axis index (E = 499 at 0.17% density)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Its excess predicts nothing at 0.17% density — exactly the case §1.9 excludes — and adding the six known-missing axes made density worse, because the box grows multiplicatively while cells grow additively.

nodes.label: Pair-completion, an instrument that does work
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Held rather than promoted: a heuristic with one confirmation from six hand-chosen cases; no completeness criterion for a coordinate set exists.

nodes.label: The charger index (E = 25, open at 3.1% density)
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Its empty JUR = 0 direction is exactly the charger shape that would close the law index — the missing cell in the charger index and the defect in the law index are one absence at two levels, and the two computations share no code.

nodes.label: The grade measure — faithful but meaningless
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A faithful measure compressing 976 cells to eighteen values exists; physics does not use it. The obstruction is not that the measure cannot be compressed but that the compression which works corresponds to nothing.

nodes.label: The self-consistent achronal ANEC
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Not a property of a universe but a relation between a spacetime and a state, G(g) = 8π⟨T⟩_ψ — which is why no coordinate of a law index can carry it. Free of counterexamples because V6 excludes them: a scoping fact about the solution index, not a physical fact.

nodes.label: The null-energy gap is a modular theory gap
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Five of six curved-space routes need a Killing field; 'K is an integral of T' and 'the OPE is organised by a symmetry group' are the same statement, so both routes fail for one reason.

nodes.label: Sorce (2024): geometric modular flow needs a conformal Killing field
nodes.rationale: Excludes the obvious repair by theorem — a near-horizon-boost extension does not exist in general; not hard, excluded.

nodes.label: HSMI on isolated horizons — the one open cell
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: An isolated horizon has Θ = 0 exactly and no Killing field, so both routes to the translation are switched off; and no third geometric route can exist because the geometry is exhausted by the definition, leaving only the state.

nodes.label: A statement generalises when its terms are defined; a proof when every hypothesis is available
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: One failure of each kind in the theorem chain: Hayden–Jozsa–Petz–Winter is unsayable in Type III until translated into Araki relative entropies; Casini–Testé–Torroba's locality has a blocked proof.

nodes.label: Freuder 1982 — tree-structured networks are globally consistent
Montanari 1974 — monotone constraints, path implies global consistency
Buniy's jurisdiction and its operative hypothesis (derivative order)
nodes.rationale: At nine letters Buniy looked like a disjunction with an unspecified price; at fifteen it is a forcing with a single currency — ghosts — and the appearance of a disjunction was the alphabet merging ghosts with Lindblad evolution.

nodes.label: Jurisdiction creates arity
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A jurisdicted forcing and an unjurisdicted disjunction give identical defects; the defect is largest at exactly one scope condition, so nearly-universal theorems are the hardest to index.

nodes.label: E is extensive under products: E(A × B) = |A|·E_B + |B|·E_A + E_A·E_B
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: The core is the invariant across products; E is not. The halves stay unjoined because there is nothing to gain and a factor of 976 to lose, and any linking constraint is cross-vocabulary.

nodes.label: The promotion ledger — PROMOTE vs HOLD
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Everything promoted is about the method; everything held is either a general claim or a physical number. The split was not planned and is the correct diagnosis: the instrument is better characterised than anything it measured.

nodes.label: The recurring class — a conclusion from an unlicensed comparison
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Thirty instances of one class, the dominant subtype being 'the encoding carries the conclusion'. The arithmetic was correct in every case; the warrant was not. The register is reported in full because the pattern of failure is itself a finding.

nodes.label: The seven propositions P1–P7
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: Four refuted, two unassertable, one conditional; none closes the index.

nodes.label: Openness is the signature, not a failure
nodes.author: Matthew Lach
nodes.rationale: A closed index is a universe; neither violation index closes, and neither does the axis index that contains them.

hyperedges.label: The four objects diagnosed by the two failure modes
